payload.criterion: Active store has no dashboard-read-only, dashboard-read-only-dashboard-bugfix, or dashboard-read-only-dashboard-features constraint; one active constraint describes human-gate CLI writes with recorded decision/note
payload.verify_command: adaptive-artifacts list --type project:constraint --state active | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s={r['subject'] for r in d['records']}; assert not s & {'dashboard-read-only','dashboard-read-only-dashboard-bugfix','dashboard-read-only-dashboard-features'}; assert any('human' in (r.get('payload',{}).get('statement') or r.get('body') or '').lower() or 'human' in r['subject'] for r in d['records'])"
